text_en: Thank the Gods you're alright... I never would have forgiven myself if something happened to you.
I suppose I should stop being so surprised at your achievements.
Me? It's nothing... Don't worry, Jivan says that I'll recover.
So, you saved this world without anyone even realising what was about to happen?
It's simply incredible that you were able to kill that beast, but something tells me that, if anyone could've, it'd be you.
How are you handling the wind orb? Looks like you've got a better grasp of it than me. That's not exactly unexpected though, you've been using those orbs for quite a while now.
No! You don't need to give it back to me. I think, from now on, I'll look for value in myself, though it would be nice to see its tricks in action.

Here's a thought... Would you dare go back to that temple? I'm sure you saw that ancient amphitheatre. I think if we get their attention enough, some of those monsters will come out and we can practice on them.
I think I can sneak out as long as my sister doesn't get wind of it. Facing her would definitely be a challenge...
When you want to try out your skills with those orbs, let me know. I don't want to miss it. That amphitheatre at the Fire Temple seems like the perfect place.
